A DMM idle-voltage measurement alone does not establish the Pocket input rating.
Check 3.3 V on U301 pins 5/3. /OE HIGH at reset. Verify waveform at TP301 with a high-impedance scope.
Confirm actual Pocket input VIH/VIL and permitted voltage/current. Radio Slave/Jack output can be
observed as evidence, but does not prove input tolerance.

waveform at TP302. Do not raise signal to 5 V without a specification.
Props OFF; FC channel monitor open
Check all four axes, sign, neutral and limits. Verify physical arm/mode controls remain independent.
Test each hand off, hub reset/freeze, stuck-high and stuck-low heartbeat, cable removal and radio restart.
Measure time until FC receives manual input.
Gestures must stay disabled until SE is released and deliberately re-enabled. Match manual throttle before
takeover to avoid a step in commanded thrust.
HEARTBEAT GATE CANDIDATE - TEST, DO NOT ASSUME
Two level checks on TR6 (>0 and <0), each with Delay 0.1 s and Duration 0, OR together as heartbeat_stuck. A healthy 45 ms half-cycle prevents either delay completing. Also
require trainer-present and TR5 valid; latch authority faults until SE release. Validate installed EdgeTX timing and startup behavior.
Sources: S17, S25-S26, S29, S33. Exact trainer circuit and receiver firmware behavior still need real hardware evidence.
